mapper.sql: FROM driver_trip_record r LEFT JOIN trip_order o ON o.id = r.order_id AND r.status = 5 AND o.status = 5 AND o.driver_id = r.driver_id LEFT JOIN trip_order_settlement s ON s.order_no = o.order_no

r.*, s.final_amount, s.coupon_discount_amount AS discount_amount, CASE WHEN s.final_amount IS NOT NULL THEN s.payable_amount END AS payable_amount, s.paid_amount, s.settlement_status, s.manual_action_required, o.mock_actual_duration_seconds AS billing_duration_seconds
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id),0) FROM driver_trip_record WHERE driver_id=#{driverId}
SELECT ORDER BY r.accepted_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{f.limit} OFFSET #{f.offset}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status=5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS completed_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status=6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS cancelled_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status=6 AND r.cancel_by=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS driver_cancelled_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status=6 AND r.cancel_by=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS passenger_cancelled_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status=6 AND r.cancel_by=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS system_cancelled_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status=5 AND s.final_amount IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS unpriced_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status=5 AND s.manual_action_required=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS abnormal_settlement_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status=5 AND (r.distance_meters IS NULL OR r.distance_meters < 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS missing_distance_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status=5 AND (r.service_duration_seconds IS NULL OR r.service_duration_seconds < 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS missing_duration_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status=5 AND s.final_amount >= 0 AND COALESCE(s.manual_action_required,0)=0 THEN s.final_amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS order_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status=5 AND r.distance_meters >= 0 THEN r.distance_meters ELSE 0 END),0) AS distance_meters, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status=5 AND r.service_duration_seconds >= 0 THEN r.service_duration_seconds ELSE 0 END),0) AS service_duration_seconds
WHERE r.driver_id=#{driverId} AND ((r.status=5 AND r.finished_at >= #{start} AND r.finished_at < #{end}) OR (r.status=6 AND r.cancelled_at >= #{start} AND r.cancelled_at < #{end}))
